L1: /**
L2:  * First-run discovery and status documents: `GET /v1` (JSON), `GET /` (small HTML page) and the
L3:  * authenticated `GET /plugboard/status`. Pure builders over the options, the catalog and a runtime
L4:  * snapshot; no I/O, no host calls. `src/openai/route.ts` loads the catalog and sends the result.
L5:  *
L6:  * Disclosure rule: the discovery pages are reachable without a key, so they only describe the
L7:  * configuration when that is safe. On a keyless endpoint (loopback only) everything is shown.
L8:  * When `keys` are configured, a caller without an `Authorization` header sees the address, the
L9:  * authentication requirement, the endpoint list and a curl example, and nothing about apps,
L10:  * allowlist, aliases or the catalog. A caller with a valid key additionally sees its own app name
L11:  * (never the other apps), the allowlist, the aliases and the catalog suggestion. Keys themselves
L12:  * never appear anywhere, and nothing here echoes a request header or path.
L13:  *
L14:  * The HTML page is built from the same document as the JSON, has no scripts or external assets,
L15:  * and every dynamic value goes through `escapeHtml`.
L16:  */

opencode-plugboard

Your OpenCode logins, served as an API

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/opencode-plugboard)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-plugboard) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/opencode-plugboard)](https://github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard/blob/main/LICENSE) [![CI](https://github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard/badge)](https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard)
Use the models you already log in to in OpenCode (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode Go and the rest) from any app that speaks the OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini API. Plugboard is an OpenCode V2 plugin. It opens an HTTP listener inside your OpenCode server and answers those APIs with your connected providers. Each app gets its own key, model list and limits. Tool calls go back to your app; OpenCode never runs them. Documentation: **https://jjjermiah.github.io/opencode-plugboard** ## Install ```sh bunx opencode-plugboard@latest init --fast anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 ``` This adds plugboard to your global OpenCode config (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc`), creates a key for one app, allows every model you are logged in to, and prints the key. Use a model you are logged in to; without `--fast`, call a model id from `GET /v1/models`. Restart OpenCode, then run `opencode api get /api/agent` once so it loads the plugin. To write the entry by hand instead: ```jsonc { "plugins": [ { "package": "opencode-plugboard@0.66.0", "options": { "keys": { "my-app": "{env:PLUGBOARD_KEY_MY_APP}" }, "models": "all", "aliases": { "fast": "anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5" } } } ] } ``` ## First request ```sh export PLUGBOARD_KEY= curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4010/v1/chat/completions \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $PLUGBOARD_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"model": "fast", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "reply with exactly: pong"}]}' \ | jq -r '.choices[0].message.content' ``` Any SDK works the same way: set its base URL to `http://127.0.0.1:4010/v1` (Anthropic and Gemini SDKs: `http://127.0.0.1:4010`) and its API key to your plugboard key. ## What it serves | API | Endpoints | | --- | --- | | OpenAI Chat Completions | `POST /v1/chat/completions` | | OpenAI Responses | `POST /v1/responses`, `GET`/`DELETE /v1/responses/{id}`, `GET /v1/responses/{id}/input_items` | | Anthropic Messages | `POST /v1/messages`, `POST /v1/messages/count_tokens` | | Gemini | `POST /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent`, `:streamGenerateContent`, `:countTokens` | | Files | `/v1/files` (OpenAI and Anthropic), `/upload/v1beta/files` and `/v1beta/files` (Gemini) | | Legacy completions | `POST /v1/completions` | | Models | `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/models/{id}` | Streaming, tool calls, structured output, images, PDFs and reasoning output work through the usual SDK calls. ## Works with OpenAI, Anthropic and Google SDKs for Python, JavaScript, Go, .NET and Rust; LangChain, LlamaIndex, pydantic-ai, the Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI and other agent frameworks; Open WebUI, LibreChat, n8n, Dify and Home Assistant; Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Aider, Cline, Continue and Zed. Setup for each: [client pages](https://jjjermiah.github.io/opencode-plugboard/clients/). ## Features - [Per-app keys and rules](https://jjjermiah.github.io/opencode-plugboard/guides/apps-and-keys): each app has its own model scope, system prompt, endpoints and caps. - [Aliases and fallbacks](https://jjjermiah.github.io/opencode-plugboard/guides/models-and-aliases): short model names, and chains that move to the next model when one fails. - [Limits, budgets and caching](https://jjjermiah.github.io/opencode-plugboard/guides/limits-budgets-and-caching): concurrency, request rate, daily or monthly spend, and a response cache. - [Tools, structured output, images and files](https://jjjermiah.github.io/opencode-plugboard/guides/tools-output-and-images). - [History, usage and monitoring](https://jjjermiah.github.io/opencode-plugboard/guides/history-usage-and-monitoring): per-app usage, a dashboard, a TUI page and Prometheus metrics. - [Serving other machines](https://jjjermiah.github.io/opencode-plugboard/guides/serving-other-machines) from an always-on OpenCode server. Plugboard is 0.x: a minor release can change an option or a default. Read the [changelog](https://github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) before you move the pin. ## Project [Security policy](https://github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard/blob/main/SECURITY.md) · [Contributing](https://github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/jjjermiah/opencode-plugboard/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) MIT licensed.
